_comment: Voice-platform configuration for the Q1 use case: the call script (what the agent says) and the business rules (how it decides). Product knowledge, FAQs, objections and policies are NOT here - they are retrieved from the Q2 knowledge base at runtime.

script.greeting: Hello, this is Asha, a virtual assistant calling from Dravix Health. This call is recorded for quality and training. You recently asked for a health insurance quote. Is this a good time to talk for about three minutes?
script.consent_retry: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Is now a good time for a quick three-minute chat, yes or no?
script.ask_callback_time: No problem. When would be a better time for us to call you back?
script.callback_confirmed: Thank you. I've scheduled a callback for {time}. Have a great day!
script.not_interested: I understand. I won't take more of your time. Thank you, and have a good day.

name.ask: Great, thank you. May I know your full name?
name.reprompt: Could you tell me your name, please? For example, 'My name is Priya Sharma'.

age.reprompt: Sorry, I need your age in years to check eligibility. How old are you?

members.ask: Who would you like to cover: just yourself, or also your spouse, children or parents?
members.reprompt: Please tell me who should be covered, for example 'me and my wife' or 'myself and my parents'.

parent_age.ask: How old is the elder of your parents?
parent_age.reprompt: What is the age of your older parent, in years?

city.ask: Which city do you live in?
city.reprompt: Could you tell me the city you live in?

health.ask: Does anyone you want to cover have an existing health condition, like diabetes, blood pressure, thyroid or a heart problem?
health.reprompt: Please answer yes or no: does anyone to be covered have an existing health condition? If yes, which one?

smoker.ask: Does anyone to be covered smoke or use tobacco?
smoker.reprompt: Is anyone to be covered a smoker or tobacco user, yes or no?

budget.ask: Roughly what premium budget do you have in mind, per month or per year?
budget.reprompt: An approximate number is fine, for example 'around 1,000 rupees a month' or '12,000 a year'.

script.ask_next_step: Would you like a licensed advisor to send you a detailed quote and call you back? If yes, what time suits you?
script.closing: Thank you {name}. A licensed advisor will call you {time} with your detailed quote. Have a great day!
script.closing_no_callback: Thank you {name}. We'll email your quote summary. Have a great day!
script.unavailable_followup: I can note this question for a licensed advisor to answer when they call you.
script.out_of_domain: I can only help with Dravix Health's health insurance plans, so I don't have information on {topic}.
script.escalation: Of course. I'm connecting you to a licensed human advisor now. I've shared the details you gave me so you won't need to repeat them.
script.escalation_after_hours: I've raised a request for a licensed human advisor to call you back as soon as possible.
script.conflict: Just to confirm, earlier you said {old}, and now {new}. Which one is correct?
script.give_up_slot: No problem, the advisor can confirm that with you later.
